name: – Tomas Tobé – After § 24 – Am 16
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 24a. Condemns any interference by Israeli authorities in democratic processes, including attempts to influence electoral campaigns and elections in Member States, such as those reported during the French local elections of March 2026; calls for the publication of all reports and findings concerning such interference, in order to ensure transparency, accountability and the protection of democratic sovereignty;
